items.title: US PPI inflation surges 1.3% as gasoline prices jump 20.3% - why are Treasury yields falling?
items.summary: In September, US wholesale prices rose sharply by 1.3%, fueled by a significant increase in gasoline costs, marking the biggest monthly gain since March 2022. The Producer Price Index saw a 6.3% year-over-year rise, indicating broader inflation pressures across goods and services. Learn more about the impact on the economy and Federal Reserve interest rate decisions.

items.title: Over 850 stocks fall as US inflation fears rattle Bursa Malaysia
items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR: Bursa Malaysia closed broadly lower on Thursday, with more than 800 stocks ending in the red as hotter-than-expected US inflation fuelled concerns over further Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, triggering a sell-off across regional markets.

items.title: US labour market remains stuck in low-hire, low-fire state as inflation intensifies: Fed
items.summary: The Federal Reserve's latest Beige Book highlights persistent inflation pressures and a stagnant US labour market, with rising energy, tariff, and insurance costs hitting businesses. With September consumer inflation rising 3.7%, expectations are growing for another potential interest rate hike at the Fed's upcoming October meeting.

items.title: Gold rebounds from one-week low as dollar slips
items.summary: GOLD prices edged higher on Thursday, rebounding from a one-week low hit in the previous session, as the US dollar eased, while investors assessed the likelihood of a Federal Reserve interest rate increase this month after a hot inflation report.

items.title: Global Market: Citi expects Fed to raise rates by 25 basis points in December after hot US inflation data
items.summary: Citigroup now expects the US Federal Reserve to raise interest rates by 25 basis points in December following hotter-than-expected September inflation. The brokerage forecasts rates to remain unchanged thereafter, with rate cuts unlikely before June 2027.
